description: Containment assertions across arrays, objects, and strings. Inclusion holds when: an array contains an element deeply equal to the expected value; an object contains the expected object as a deep subset (every key in the expected object is present in the actual object with a deeply-equal value, recursing into nested objects); or a string contains the expected substring. Exclusion is the logical negation for arrays and strings. A violation diagnostic renders the container and the searched value. Inclusion accepts an array, object, or string as the actual value; exclusion accepts only an array or string; any other actual type is rejected with a neutral error category.

cases.expected_output:
check=include
outcome=violation
message=Expected 'hello world' to include 'goodbye'

check=exclude
outcome=violation
message=Expected 'hello world' to exclude 'hello'
